description: Pin an explicit variable mode on nodes or pages (e.g. a mobile frame pinned to the Spacing collection's mobile mode), or clear: true to unpin. Works on scene nodes and page ids. Echoes explicitVariableModes ({} = nothing pinned).

clear.description: Remove this collection's pin instead of setting one

modeId.description: Required unless clear is true; must belong to collectionId

name: figma_set_variable_mode
